metadata.description: Everyday and developer utility tools. Fast, accurate, and ad-free.

home.tagline: Lightning-fast utility tools for developers and everyday users. Fast, accurate, and ad-free.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.description: Beautify, validate, and minify JSON data.

markdown-viewer.name: Markdown Viewer
markdown-viewer.description: Preview Markdown with proper formatting, including tables and code blocks.

html-viewer.name: HTML Viewer
html-viewer.description: Paste raw HTML on the left, edit visually (WYSIWYG) on the right. Instant two-way sync.

base64-encode-decode.name: Base64 Encode/Decode
base64-encode-decode.description: Encode or decode text strings to and from Base64.

url-encode-decode.name: URL Encode/Decode
url-encode-decode.description: Safely encode a URL or decode it back to readable text.

jwt-decoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.description: Decode a JSON Web Token (JWT) to inspect its header and payload.

hash-generator.name: Hash Generator
hash-generator.description: Generate MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 hashes from text.

qr-generator.name: QR Code Generator
qr-generator.description: Create QR codes for links, text and wifi, with customizable colors.

color-converter.name: HEX / RGB Converter
color-converter.description: Convert color codes between HEX, RGB and HSL instantly.

image-to-base64.name: Image to Base64
image-to-base64.description: Convert image files to a Base64 string to embed in HTML/CSS.

svg-placeholder.name: Placeholder Generator
svg-placeholder.description: Quickly create standard-sized placeholder images to test layouts.

image-resizer.name: Image Resizer
image-resizer.description: Crop and resize images right in your browser.

word-counter.name: Word & Character Counter
word-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in detail.

case-converter.name: Case Converter
case-converter.description: Convert between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Capitalized Case and camelCase.

text-to-slug.name: URL Slug Generator
text-to-slug.description: Strip accents and create SEO-friendly URL slugs.

lorem-ipsum.name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
lorem-ipsum.description: Quickly generate placeholder text for UI/UX design.

remove-line-breaks.name: Remove Line Breaks & Spaces
remove-line-breaks.description: Clean up text by removing blank lines and extra whitespace.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage Calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Calculate the percentage of a number and percentage increase or decrease.

bmi-calculator.name: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Check your Body Mass Index (BMI) to assess your health.

random-number.name: Random Number Generator
random-number.description: Generate one or more random numbers within a given range.

unit-converter.name: Unit Converter
unit-converter.description: Convert length, weight, temperature and area.

rule-of-three.name: Rule of Three
rule-of-three.description: Quickly solve the rule of three (if A=B and C=D, find the unknown).

lucky-wheel.name: Lucky Wheel
lucky-wheel.description: Create a random spinning wheel with great effects. Pick people, assign tasks, decide fast.
